root_causes.name: cannot_be_scheduled
root_causes.description: no node can take its pods, for lack of CPU or memory, a taint, or an affinity or node selector no node matches

root_causes.name: image_pull_failure
root_causes.description: its image can't be pulled, for a wrong name or tag, or missing registry credentials

root_causes.name: volume_unavailable
root_causes.description: a volume it needs can't be bound or mounted

root_causes.name: init_container_failure
root_causes.description: an init container fails or never finishes

root_causes.name: startup_config_error
root_causes.description: a ConfigMap, Secret or key its containers need is missing, so they can't start

root_causes.name: quota_exceeded
root_causes.description: a namespace quota refuses new pods

root_causes.name: still_starting
root_causes.description: its pods are starting slowly and nothing has failed

root_causes.name: other
root_causes.description: none of these: say what in the summary

guidance:
No fix is on offer for these incidents: Themis diagnoses them and hands
them to a person. Tell which cause keeps the pods from becoming ready,
from the pod states and the events, and back it with the check that shows
it: scheduler_rejected_pods, image_pull_failing, volume_not_bound,
init_container_stuck, config_error_on_start or quota_refused_pods. When
the checks and the evidence point to one cause, conclude with it and cite
that evidence. When none fails and the pods are only slow, say so. When
the evidence can't tell, say what is missing.

A recent rollout doesn't make this a regression to roll back: rolling
back belongs to another kind of incident, and is never on offer here.

templates.name: pod_states
templates.description: Each pod of the Deployment: its revision, readiness, and each container's state and last termination (where OOMKilled shows).

templates.name: target_events
templates.description: Recent events of the Deployment, its ReplicaSets and its pods, newest first.

templates.name: rollout_history
templates.description: The Deployment's rollout progress, conditions, GitOps ownership markers, and each ReplicaSet revision with its images and resource limits.

templates.name: referenced_config
templates.description: The ConfigMaps and Secrets the pod template refers to, and when each ConfigMap last changed. Names and times only, never values.

templates.name: container_logs_tail
templates.description: The end of one container's logs. Defaults to the pod needing attention most, from the run that last ended.

predicates.name: scheduler_rejected_pods
predicates.reason: the 1 pod(s) that aren't ready were all scheduled

predicates.name: image_pull_failing
predicates.reason: no container of the 1 pod(s) that aren't ready is waiting for its image

predicates.name: volume_not_bound
predicates.reason: no event says a volume of the 1 pod(s) that aren't ready can't be bound or mounted

predicates.name: init_container_stuck
predicates.reason: no init container of the 1 pod(s) that aren't ready failed or ran longer than 5m0s

predicates.name: config_error_on_start
predicates.reason: no container waits for its configuration, and every ConfigMap the pods need exists

predicates.name: quota_refused_pods
predicates.reason: no event says a quota refused a pod

predicates.name: stuck_pods_new_revision_only
predicates.reason: the 1 pod(s) that aren't ready are all of revision 5, and 3 pod(s) of revision 4 are ready
